bg.body.$description: Used for large white backgrounds, the default background of page main content, often used in content areas and active views

bg.base.$description: Used for large gray backgrounds, such as the background behind content areas

bg.body-overlay.$description: Used for gray backgrounds layered on white backgrounds, such as cards and content areas

bg.float.$description: Used for white floating-layer backgrounds, such as dialogs, popover cards, and menus

bg.float-overlay.$description: Used for gray backgrounds layered on white floating layers, such as cards

bg.float-push.$description: Used for in-app IM notification backgrounds

bg.text-selection.$description: Used for selected text background color

bg.pricolor.$description: Used for large-area theme-color guidance scenarios

shadow.default.$description: Used for default shadow color of UI elements, such as floating buttons

shadow.default-sm.$description: Used for shadow color of small-area elements such as bottom action bars, basic content cards, and sticky table headers; applied to bottom action bars, top primary navigation, basic content cards, sticky table headers, right drawers, and left navigation

shadow.default-md.$description: Used for shadow color of medium-area elements such as toolbars, notifications, and dropdown menus; applied to toolbars, side drawers, notifications, dropdown select, tree select, cascader, dropdown menu, global message, floating button, tooltip, and blue floating button

shadow.default-lg.$description: Used for shadow color of large-area elements such as large cards and content pages; applied to hover / click / drag-and-drop states of page-module cards, individual cards, and notifications

shadow.pri-lg.$description: Used for shadow color of large-area blue theme elements, such as guide cards

fill.pressed.$description: Used for pressed state colors, such as text buttons and icon buttons

fill.focus.$description: Used for keyboard focus state colors, such as text buttons and icon buttons

fill.tag.$description: Used for inner stroke color of Department Avatar and similar components

fill.loading-mask.$description: Used for loading process colors, such as masks behind loading data in dropdown panels, skeletons, and placeholders

fill.img-mask.$description: Used to darken images and avoid overexposure of large images in dark mode; this token can darken images and is fully transparent in Light Mode

static.white.$description: Static white, unchanged between light and dark modes, often used for text and icons on filled colors
